{
"title": "Prepare liquidity planning analysis for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Prepare a liquidity planning analysis for Mira Thimblefern showing how much of the $4.25 million sale proceeds should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment, considering her goal of keeping two years of spending in low-volatility accounts.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-09-05",
"assigneeId": "04250424-b280-5443-9318-1c2f184393c9",
"templateId": "08361f27-bfef-5da9-85f9-5136b2a38dcc",
"evidence": "For the liquidity plan for business sale proceeds, Mira asked for an analysis showing how much sale cash should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment; the agreed follow-up is due September 5, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Collect closing packet documents for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Collect the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet for Mira Thimblefern's business sale to verify net proceeds and escrow treatment.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-29",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the closing packet for the business sale, the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet were not yet in Mira's planning file, and those documents are needed to verify net proceeds and escrow treatment by August 29, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Trace net proceeds variance for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Trace the difference between the broker's estimated net cash amount and the actual $3.71 million incoming wire for Mira Thimblefern to identify fees, debt payoff, escrow, or separate expected transfers.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-27",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the net proceeds variance, the broker's proceeds memo showed a higher estimated net cash amount than the actual incoming bank wire, and the difference needs to be traced to fees, debt payoff, escrow, or a separate expected transfer by August 27, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Coordinate estimated tax planning with Tobin Mossbutton",
"text": "Coordinate with Tobin Mossbutton of Apricot Compass Tax to compare Mira Thimblefern's sale proceeds, consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-09-12",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For CPA coordination on estimated taxes, Mira wants the advisory team and Tobin Mossbutton to compare sale proceeds, consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision; the agreed follow-up is due September 12, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Gather health coverage details for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Gather premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement health coverage for Mira Thimblefern before she chooses an option after her former company coverage ends.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-09-20",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For health coverage after the operating role ends, Mira's former company coverage is expected to end after the transition period, and premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement coverage are needed before choosing an option by September 20, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Resolve Teacup Comet Bank transfer hold for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Resolve the temporary outbound online transfer limitation on Mira Thimblefern's Teacup Comet Bank checking account to allow efficient movement of excess cash to custody or treasury vehicles.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-25",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the bank transfer hold on sale proceeds, Mira reported that Teacup Comet Bank temporarily limited outbound online transfers from the account that received the sale wire, preventing efficient movement of excess cash to custody or treasury vehicles; the agreed follow-up is due August 25, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
},
{
"title": "Update estate file for Mira Thimblefern",
"text": "Update Mira Thimblefern's estate file to remove references to the operating business interest and obtain current signed copies of any post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-09-10",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"evidence": "For the estate file update after sale, the advisory review found that the estate file on record still references the operating business interest and lacks current signed copies of any post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates; the agreed follow-up is due September 10, 2025."
,
"subTasks": []
}
]
